reason: X describes all four planted exceptions (duplicate not renamed, UNKNOWN-DATE still filed, over-500 review needed, type from client list) in variations and procedure. It keeps a separate rename stage and states the TYPE_DATE_NAME change correctly, with old files left unchanged. Y has a nice client-types.txt lookup stage and real timings, but it ties the scans to the HP printer setup (the unrelated one-off job), says 3 days and 'two capture windows', and keeps missing-date and over-500 only in the description. Both give the rule change correctly and both get the day count wrong (5 days, 12 scans), so the margin is small.
